sections.title: Current reviewed calculations
sections.sql: select * from claim_round order by voyage,port

sections.title: Claim deadlines
sections.sql: select * from time_bars order by time_bar_at nulls first

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select * from compliance_checks order by voyage,rule

sections.title: Active exceptions
sections.sql: select p.code port_call,e.starts_at,e.ends_at,e.reason,e.clause_ref,e.on_demurrage from active_exceptions e join port_calls p on p.id=e.port_id order by p.code,e.starts_at

sections.title: Source events awaiting interpretation
sections.sql: select p.code port_call,e.source_key,e.occurred_at,e.description,e.counts,e.factor from source_events e join port_calls p on p.id=e.port_id order by p.code,e.occurred_at
